context_files_read.purpose: controlling repository instructions and artifact integrity rules
key_findings: Machine-readable artifacts are the product; charts, HTML, and Markdown are views over versioned artifacts.
Missing metrics and evidence must be encoded as MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON and never invented.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN must not run without explicit opt-in and must not count as real 1000-node evidence.
Historical phase, gate, schema, script, template, docs, and workflow controls must not be weakened to make a later check pass.

context_files_read.purpose: automatic phase loop and P14 boundary
key_findings: Automatic completion stops at P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100.
P14 is intentionally not automatic and requires VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN=I_UNDERSTAND_THIS_IS_NOT_A_DEFAULT_GATE.
Gate results must be produced by scripts/codex_gate.py run, not manual PASS edits.
Each stage must re-read context and persist stage artifacts under artifacts/loop_engineering.
Stage completion requires previous harness pass, current harness design and implementation, validation, anti-regression review, stage_result PASS, commit, and push.
If resources are insufficient for real Valkey stages, the stage must record blockers rather than mark PASS.

context_files_read.purpose: L02 stage definition and acceptance criteria
key_findings: L02 must build an artifact provenance DAG.
Required harness additions are a provenance graph builder, DAG schema, source artifact hash check, and tests proving reports read artifacts but never become source-of-truth.
P09 report, P12/P13 scale report, and P11 stability report must trace to source artifacts.
Any visualization or analysis item without a source must be recorded as a finding.
The required graph output is artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json.
L02 is expected to be static artifact validation and should not run P14 or real/fault wrapper gates.
Reports must never become source-of-truth.
Historical artifacts may lack producer, run_id, or provenance fields; L02 must classify gaps rather than mutate committed artifacts.
P14 dry-run artifacts from P02 must not be represented as real 1000-node provenance.
L00 status is PASS and pushed.
Loop validation harness, subagent schema, command log schema, stage result schema, and anti-regression entrypoint are established.
L00 remaining risk notes that stage_result commit SHA bookkeeping is a follow-up artifact pattern.
L01 status is PASS and pushed.
Committed artifact audit report and gate are established.
L01 records historical manifest SHA drift through an allowlist and does not rewrite historical gate results.
agent_role must be one of the declared subagent roles and this file must use requirements_analyst.
verdict must be APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, or BLOCKED.
Top-level additionalProperties are forbidden.
proposed_harness entries require name, type, expected_to_fail_before_impl, and acceptance.
analysis_summary requires schema_version, artifact_type, phase_id, run_id, created_at, producer, status, findings, and missing_metrics.
The schema allows additionalProperties, which can carry source_artifacts but does not require them.
report_index requires metadata plus a reports array with path and sha256 for rendered outputs.
The schema does not require source_artifacts, so L02 must enforce upstream report provenance outside the existing report_index schema.
Rendered report files listed by report_index must be treated as views, not source artifacts.
stability_report requires metadata, duration_seconds, and summary.
The schema does not require source_artifacts or a metrics JSONL path.
L02 must add provenance checks for stability_report inputs such as stability_metrics.jsonl, stability_baseline_comparison.json, valkey_e2e_evidence.json, and cleanup_report.json.
scale_ladder_report requires metadata, rungs, and summary.
The schema does not require source_artifacts.
Existing rungs include evidence_path values and summaries include real_evidence_paths, which can seed deterministic provenance edges but still need hash verification.

P12 and P13 scale reports must trace each rung to its matching resource_preflight artifact.
cleanup_report requires resources_remaining and cleanup_actions.

Phase summaries can provide manifest-declared artifact inventory but should not replace detailed source artifacts.
p13_timing_breakdown requires scenario, node_count, timings, summary, accounting, producer, run_id, and status.
The schema does not require source_artifacts even though timing fields are derived from setup, wrapper, probe, cleanup, and accounting artifacts.

analysis_summary already includes source_artifacts with paths and sha256 values for P08 cleanup, failover, fault, phase summary, state, and valkey_e2e_evidence artifacts.

The source_artifacts hashes must be verified against committed files by L02 rather than trusted blindly.

stability_report contains measured duration, workload latency, memory growth, restart deltas, error classification, and baseline comparison summary.

scale_ladder_report has real 50-node and 100-node rung summaries with evidence_path values and Valkey 9.1.0 versions.
source_artifacts is absent/null.

The artifact records setup, cluster create, replica config, wrapper probe, final probe, cleanup, artifact write, and accounting timings.

findings.description: There is no committed provenance DAG contract or graph output for analysis, report, stability, scale, timing, and rendered artifacts. L02 must add a schema-backed graph at artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json.
evidence: codex/loop_engineering/04_STAGE_MANIFEST.md requires a provenance graph builder, DAG schema, source artifact hash check, and graph output path.
artifacts/loop_engineering/reports currently contains audit_report.json but no provenance_graph.json.
Existing artifact schemas allow source_artifacts as additionalProperties but do not require a unified DAG.

findings.description: Rendered P09 report outputs are indexed with hashes but are not linked to their source analysis artifact. The graph must mark report files as views and trace them to analysis_summary.json and then to P08 source artifacts.

artifacts/phases/P09_ANALYSIS_REPORTING/analysis_summary.json already lists P08 source_artifacts with sha256.

evidence: artifacts/phases/P11_STABILITY_SOAK/stability_report.json has source_artifacts null and metrics_path null.
artifacts/phases/P11_STABILITY_SOAK/stability_metrics.jsonl and stability_baseline_comparison.json exist as representative upstream artifacts.

findings.description: Source artifact hashes must be recomputed from disk and compared to declared hashes. A graph that merely copies source_artifacts or report_index hashes would not satisfy L02.

The L02 read_context.md warns that existing historical artifacts may lack metadata and must classify gaps without mutating committed artifacts.

proposed_harness.name: provenance_graph_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: schemas/artifact/provenance_graph.schema.json requires schema_version, artifact_type=provenance_graph, generated_at, producer, status, scope, nodes, edges, findings, and summary. Nodes must include id, path, sha256_actual, artifact_type, schema_path or null, phase_id or null, run_id or null, producer or null, status or null, source_of_truth boolean, artifact_role, and hash_status. Edges must include from, to, relation, source_declaration, hash_status, and evidence.

proposed_harness.name: provenance_graph_builder_cli
proposed_harness.acceptance: python3 scripts/build_provenance_graph.py --out artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json deterministically reads committed artifacts and writes a schema-valid DAG without running P14, scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, or scripts/fault_failover_gate.py.

proposed_harness.name: source_artifact_hash_check
proposed_harness.acceptance: Tests prove every declared source_artifacts sha256 and every report_index report sha256 is recomputed from disk; missing files and mismatches produce findings with severity, path, expected_sha256, actual_sha256 or MISSING, and blocking=true for source artifacts required by L02 scope.

proposed_harness.name: report_view_not_source_of_truth_test
proposed_harness.acceptance: Tests prove HTML, Markdown, SVG, and CSV report files from P09 are graph nodes with source_of_truth=false and incoming provenance from analysis_summary.json; no report file is allowed to be the terminal source for a metric or conclusion.

proposed_harness.name: p09_p11_p12_p13_traceability_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Tests verify graph paths exist from P09 report files to P09 analysis_summary and P08 source artifacts; from P11 stability_report to stability_metrics.jsonl, stability_baseline_comparison.json, valkey_e2e_evidence.json, cleanup_report.json, and phase_summary.json; from P12 scale_ladder_report to 10/30 preflight, evidence, rung, cleanup, and summary artifacts; and from P13 scale_ladder_report to 50/100 preflight, evidence, rung, cleanup, timing, and summary artifacts.

proposed_harness.name: missing_provenance_finding_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Fixture tests create analysis, stability, scale, timing, and visualization artifacts with no explicit or deterministic source; the builder must emit MISSING_PROVENANCE findings instead of inventing source values.

proposed_harness.name: dag_integrity_and_no_p14_real_evidence_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Tests prove the graph is acyclic, every edge endpoint exists, P14 real_valkey coverage is absent, dry-run/planner nodes are labeled dry_run_only when present, and 1000-node dry-run artifacts never satisfy real evidence traceability.

proposed_harness.name: provenance_graph_ci_gate
proposed_harness.acceptance: A CI test asserts the builder CLI, schema validation, hash checks, and report-as-view tests are part of the validation path without invoking real Valkey, fault wrappers, Docker cluster creation, or P14.

implementation_plan.step: Define the provenance graph artifact schema before implementation.
implementation_plan.rationale: The DAG must be machine-readable and strict enough to prevent empty graphs, unverified hashes, missing endpoints, and report files being treated as sources.

implementation_plan.step: Build a static provenance graph builder over committed artifact files.
implementation_plan.rationale: L02 should derive provenance from existing JSON/JSONL/CSV/SVG/HTML/Markdown artifacts, phase manifest commands, declared source_artifacts, report_index entries, and deterministic phase-specific path rules without running real gates.

implementation_plan.step: Implement explicit and inferred edge handling with hash verification.
implementation_plan.rationale: Existing artifacts mix explicit source_artifacts with missing/null provenance fields; the graph must record source_declaration as explicit, manifest_command, known_phase_artifact, report_index, or unresolved and must recompute hashes for every linked file.

implementation_plan.step: Add focused provenance tests for L02 target phases and negative fixtures.
implementation_plan.rationale: Tests must prove concrete traceability for P09, P11, P12, and P13 while blocking missing source edges and hash drift.

implementation_plan.step: Add CI guard coverage for the provenance gate.
implementation_plan.rationale: The provenance DAG must remain part of the committed validation path and must stay static-only.

implementation_plan.step: Generate the L02 graph artifact through the builder.
implementation_plan.rationale: The graph output is a product artifact and must be reproducible from committed inputs rather than handwritten.

acceptance_criteria: artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json exists, is generated by the L02 builder, and validates against schemas/artifact/provenance_graph.schema.json.

The graph status is PASS only when there are no blocking findings; unresolved source provenance, missing required source files, or hash mismatches for L02-required source artifacts are blocking findings.

Every graph node has path, sha256_actual, hash_status, artifact_role, source_of_truth, artifact_type when available, schema_path when known, phase_id when available, run_id when available, producer when available, and status when available.

Every graph edge has existing from/to node ids, relation, source_declaration, hash_status, and evidence explaining whether the edge came from source_artifacts, report_index, manifest command input, known phase artifact mapping, or deterministic artifact field such as evidence_path.
The graph is a DAG: validation fails if any cycle exists or any edge endpoint is missing.

For P09_ANALYSIS_REPORTING, graph paths exist from report/metrics.csv, report/missing_metrics.csv, report/baseline_comparison.csv, report/metric_chart.svg, report/report.md, and report/index.html to report_index.json, analysis_summary.json, and the P08 source artifacts declared in analysis_summary.json.

P09 rendered report nodes have source_of_truth=false and artifact_role values such as rendered_report, visualization, markdown_report, html_report, or csv_view; they are never accepted as source nodes for measured metrics.
Every sha256 declared in P09 analysis_summary.json source_artifacts and P09 report_index.json reports is recomputed from disk and recorded as MATCH, MISMATCH, or MISSING.

For P11_STABILITY_SOAK, graph paths exist from stability_report.json to stability_metrics.jsonl, stability_baseline_comparison.json, valkey_e2e_evidence.json, cleanup_report.json, and phase_summary.json; missing explicit provenance in the historical artifact is either represented by deterministic inferred edges or by a non-hidden finding.

For P12_SCALE_LADDER_10_30, graph paths exist from scale_ladder_report.json to resource_preflight_10.json, resource_preflight_30.json, valkey_e2e_evidence_10.json, valkey_e2e_evidence_30.json, scale_rung_10.json, scale_rung_30.json, cleanup_report.json or per-scenario cleanup reports, and phase_summary.json.

For P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100, graph paths exist from scale_ladder_report.json to resource_preflight_50.json, resource_preflight_100.json, valkey_e2e_evidence_50.json, valkey_e2e_evidence_100.json, scale_rung_50.json, scale_rung_100.json, cleanup_report.json or per-scenario cleanup reports, p13_timing_breakdown_scale_50.json, p13_timing_breakdown_scale_100.json, and phase_summary.json.

P13 timing breakdown nodes trace to available setup_timeline_scale_N.json, runtime_timing_breakdown_scale_N.json, valkey_e2e_evidence_N.json, cleanup_report_scale_N.json, and setup/cleanup log artifacts where present; any unavailable timing source is recorded as MISSING_PROVENANCE with reason and impact.
MISSING values already present in artifacts, such as diagnostic_full_probe_duration_seconds=MISSING, remain represented as missing evidence and are not backfilled with invented values.

P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is not run; no L02 command invokes scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, scripts/fault_failover_gate.py, Docker cluster creation, or P14 real/dry-run execution.
If 1000-node dry-run/planner artifacts are included in the graph, they are marked dry_run_only=true, source_of_truth=false for real evidence coverage, and real_valkey_coverage=false.
The builder does not edit artifacts/phases, artifacts/gates, audit decisions, source code outputs from prior phases, or historical report files to repair provenance gaps.

tests/provenance include negative fixtures for missing source_artifacts, broken source paths, sha256 mismatch, source cycles, missing edge endpoints, and report nodes incorrectly marked source_of_truth=true.
The L02 validation path remains static and fast: it validates schemas, graph integrity, hashes, and tests without requiring live Valkey, Docker availability, host network changes, or fault injection.
risks: A graph builder that only follows explicit source_artifacts will miss P09 report_index, P11 stability_report, P12 scale_ladder_report, P13 scale_ladder_report, and P13 timing artifacts because those samples have null or absent source_artifacts.
A graph builder that relies only on filename heuristics can invent false provenance; inferred edges must record their derivation and produce findings when confidence is insufficient.
Copying sha256 values from artifacts without recomputing them would fail the source artifact hash requirement.
Rendered report files could accidentally become source-of-truth unless the schema and tests force source_of_truth=false for HTML, Markdown, SVG, and CSV views.
P13 nodehost bundles and large node config trees could make the graph noisy; L02 should include them only when they are actual sources for a target report or timing artifact.
Including P14 dry-run artifacts without strong labels could make later coverage stages mistake dry-run planning for real 1000-node evidence.
Relaxing existing artifact schemas or rewriting historical artifacts to add source_artifacts would violate the requested scope and the harness integrity rules.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not edit source files, tests, historical phase artifacts, historical gate artifacts, or historical audit decisions as part of this requirements_analyst output.
Do not run scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, or scripts/fault_failover_gate.py for L02 requirements analysis.
Do not treat report_index.json, HTML, Markdown, SVG, or CSV outputs as source-of-truth for measured values.
Do not copy declared sha256 values into the graph without recomputing file hashes.
Do not silently ignore missing source_artifacts on analysis, report, scale, stability, timing, or visualization artifacts.
Do not fabricate source paths, run_id values, producer metadata, or missing metrics to make the graph complete.
Do not weaken AGENTS.md, codex/phase_manifest.json, schemas, scripts, workflows, templates, or loop-engineering requirements to pass L02.
Do not count dry-run planner/resource artifacts as real Valkey evidence or real 1000-node provenance.
notes: L02 requirements are concrete enough to proceed: the stage must add a schema-backed static provenance DAG, verify hashes from disk, prove report artifacts are views, trace P09/P11/P12/P13 target artifacts to source artifacts, and emit machine-readable findings for unresolved provenance. This requirements artifact intentionally performs no implementation work and does not mutate historical phase or gate evidence.
